en: No rules to learn first. Pick a way to set out and the city will tell the rest.
zh-Hans: 不用先学规则。挑一种出发方式，城市自己会讲下去。

en: Check in stop by stop and set out together at the start time. Good for meetups and story routes.
zh-Hans: 按顺序打卡通关，到点了大家一起出发。适合约人、适合有剧情的路线。

en: Every stop is open; start wherever you like. Get a pass and play any time without waiting for a full group.
zh-Hans: 点位全开，想从哪个开始都行。买张通行证随时开玩，不用等人凑齐。

en: Light up the city's fog as you walk, with no tasks and no finish line. A stroll on the way counts too.
zh-Hans: 边走边点亮城市迷雾，没有任务也没有终点。顺路散个步也算数。

en: They will appear here once published
zh-Hans: 内容上线后会出现在这里
